name: postiz-app
description: 📨 The ultimate agentic social media scheduling tool 🤖
one_liner: A scheduling tool that plans, writes and posts your social media content automatically across platforms, with an AI agent doing the busywork.
buyer: A small business owner or solo social media manager juggling multiple client accounts who wants to automate scheduling and content drafting.
business_use_cases: A freelance social media manager runs it to handle scheduling and first-draft captions for five client accounts at once.
A small e-commerce brand automates its own posting calendar instead of paying for Buffer or Hootsuite.
An agency self-hosts it to offer white-labeled social scheduling as part of a broader marketing retainer without paying per-seat SaaS fees.

money_ideas.idea: Self-host it and resell managed social media scheduling to small businesses as a monthly retainer.
Offer a one-off 'set up your automated posting calendar' service for small business owners.

steal_this: Self-host it this weekend, connect two of your own social accounts, and offer a free month of automated posting to one local business to get a testimonial.
